program.blurb: No equipment and no repeats: push-ups, floor pulls, legs, jumps and boxing, a new pairing every day.
program.about: No equipment, and no two days alike. Each day deals a kind of training you can do on the floor, push-ups, floor pulls, legs, glutes, shoulders, arms, HIIT, jumps, boxing, kickboxing, running drills and core, with a format to match. Sixty days, no pair twice, never the same kind two days running. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
